abstract: During the last 14 years repeated sperm cell analyses and serum hormone analysis were done regularly in patients with testicular cancer before and after treatment. The summarized results are hereby reported. The sperm cell count was highly impaired in 60-70% of testicular cancer patients evaluated 1-4 weeks after unilateral orchidectomy before further treatment. However, improvement of the exocrine gonadal function was regularly observed during the following 2-3 years, provided there were normal or only slightly elevated pre-treatment FSH levels. Standard irradiation and cytotoxic treatment (abdominal radiotherapy 30-40 Gy; < or = 4 cycles of cisplatin-based chemotherapy) delayed this recovery by about one year. Higher doses of chemotherapy or combined irradiation/chemotherapy reduced the chances of rapid improvement of the exocrine gonadal function. Unilateral retroperitoneal lymph node dissection resulted in a slight reduction of the post-treatment ejaculatory volume, even in patients with preserved antegrade ejaculation.
abstract_ja: 過去14年間にわたり、精巣がん患者の治療前後に精子解析と血清ホルモン分析を定期的に実施した。その結果を報告する。片側精巣摘除後1〜4週間の時点で、精子数は60〜70%の患者で著しく低下していた。しかし、治療前のFSH値が正常または軽度上昇にとどまる場合は、その後2〜3年にわたり外分泌性の精巣機能が通常改善した。標準的な放射線療法（腹部への30〜40Gy）および細胞毒性化学療法（シスプラチン併用化学療法4サイクル以下）は、この回復を約1年遅らせた。より高用量の化学療法や放射線療法と化学療法の併用は、外分泌機能の急速な回復の可能性をさらに低下させた。片側の後腹膜リンパ節郭清では、順行性射精が保たれた患者においても、治療後の射精量がわずかに減少した。
